who_may_create: Authorized worker acting under exact command
required_evidence: Exact return ref; required artifacts; PASS/FAIL evidence at assigned ceiling
jurisdiction: Worker task only unless charter expressly grants terminal dispositive power
inheritance_rule: No automatic inheritance; governing layer must admit/adopt or successor must explicitly consume under lawful charter
downstream_reliance: NO outside worker task; YES only for evidence inspection by governing court
global_hq_rebanking_required: YES for global effect; NO if later delegated controller lawfully accepts it only inside delegated scope
supersession_rule: Same delegated/governing controller or superior authority may correct/reject/supersede; worker cannot self-promote

required_evidence: Exact immutable identity; evidence/provenance/hash; explicit evidentiary admission; proof ceiling
jurisdiction: Only proposition/grain expressly admitted as evidence
inheritance_rule: Inherited only as evidence at same ceiling; stronger later proof may replace evidentiary function
downstream_reliance: YES as evidence only; NO semantic/runtime widening
global_hq_rebanking_required: YES if creator is delegated and evidence is to bind outside delegated jurisdiction; NO if already HQ-admitted
supersession_rule: May be functionally superseded by stronger verified evidence; surviving facts remain only if explicitly preserved

who_may_create: Delegated campaign/control branch created by superior authority and acting inside charter
required_evidence: Parent charter; exact artifact/claim identity; explicit admission/freeze/binding consumption; required QA/provenance; negative ceilings
jurisdiction: Exact delegated campaign grain and scope only
inheritance_rule: May bind descendants/authorized sibling-consuming courts inside campaign when contract says consume/freeze/immutable; does not escape charter by ancestry
downstream_reliance: YES inside delegated worker DAG at exact grain
global_hq_rebanking_required: NO for internal delegated reliance; YES for project-wide/global-HQ effect or powers reserved to HQ
may_define_canonical_git_base: MAY define campaign worker base if charter permits; NEVER canonical global base solely by delegation
supersession_rule: Same delegated controller within scope or superior HQ may correct/supersede; superior authority prevails on collision

who_may_create: Global HQ / competent global sovereign control
required_evidence: Exact identified holding; explicit HQ accept/adopt/bank/inherit act; required proof and ceiling
inheritance_rule: May be inherited by ancestry OR exact immutable-ref adoption/re-inheritance; source branch need not become trunk
downstream_reliance: YES at the exact banked grain, subject to currentness and later rulings
may_define_canonical_git_base: NOT AUTOMATICALLY; HQ may designate a global base separately, but banking alone does not establish canonical ancestry
supersession_rule: Later competent HQ/global sovereign ruling may revoke/narrow/supersede; newer files alone do not

who_may_create: Competent governing layer at the same scope: delegated control for campaign-current, HQ for globally-current
required_evidence: Explicit current-selection/freeze OR successor contract that treats exact holding as closed/immutable/current
jurisdiction: Exactly the scope/grain of current selection
inheritance_rule: Carries only while successor dependency or current-selection law remains in force
global_hq_rebanking_required: YES if a delegated-current holding is to become globally current; NO for its existing delegated currentness
supersession_rule: Only explicit same-scope or superior current-selection/correction; NEWEST does not supersede CURRENT

who_may_create: Existing global sovereign/HQ through explicit project-level succession or transfer
required_evidence: Explicit project-wide authority succession/re-inheritance; governing control identity; authority chain
jurisdiction: Global project governance and reserved decisions
inheritance_rule: Successor must explicitly inherit/replace global control; subordinate accumulation cannot self-create sovereignty
downstream_reliance: YES project-wide subject to grain-specific law
may_define_canonical_git_base: YES, may designate canonical global control/base; actual ancestry remains separately provable
supersession_rule: Only competent global project-level succession/correction can replace it

who_may_create: HQ or delegated preservation authority within its charter
required_evidence: Exact immutable ref; complete preservation census/obligation envelope; explicit preservation acceptance; nonpromotion ceiling
inheritance_rule: Future work must preserve or explicitly disposition every binding obligation; exact-ref inheritance lawful
downstream_reliance: YES as a preservation constraint/obligation; NO as live semantic/runtime authority unless separately promoted
global_hq_rebanking_required: YES for global preservation effect if created only by delegated layer; NO if HQ accepted
supersession_rule: May be replaced only by explicit same-or-stronger preservation/succession ruling with no silent loss

required_evidence: Explicit correction/revocation/supersession; predecessor and successor/grain identities
jurisdiction: Historical/provenance only except surviving narrowed holdings
inheritance_rule: Retained for genealogy/replay, not silently resurrected
downstream_reliance: NO as current authority; YES as historical provenance where needed
supersession_rule: May only regain live authority through a new explicit competent adoption; recency or branch survival is insufficient

who_may_create: Git history establishes ancestry; global sovereign control normatively designates canonical base/trunk where required
required_evidence: Actual DAG/merge/ref evidence plus explicit canonical designation for normative base claims
inheritance_rule: Ancestral containment transports bytes/history but does not itself adjudicate semantic acceptance
may_define_canonical_git_base: YES only when global sovereign control designates it; topology alone cannot
supersession_rule: Changed only by actual Git succession/base designation; semantic acceptance can move independently by immutable ref
